{{Top|leg}}
'''Recycling droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]], often used on specialized research and exploratory [[Starship/Legends|starships]] designed to spend [[Standard month/Legends|months]] or even [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. One of their main jobs was to be able to turn organic refuse and waste into bland, but edible, [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bars]] and [[protein wafer]]s.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

The ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' carried a large number of [[Gyrowheel 1.42.08-series recycling droid]]s aboard. Some recycling droids possessed equipment capable of transforming matter into raw molecular paste. [[Gorm (cyborg)|Gorm the Dissolver]] used to wield such an appendage, which led to him gaining his nickname. Gorm lost the arm in battle with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="EGTD" />
